items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC6 each have a test; AC7 run for real against the B2b branch brief_intake (custom / inferred / hostile / unknown name), re-run on merged #923 pending.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: extractFindings nulls only the bad key; scan failures keep samples with a note; unusable names never reach the brief.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Snapshot text capped, cleaned, names-only for commands, rendered as React text, no-store, not logged; user text neutralised before the Intake trailer.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Ported-reader contract test on real composeNewBrief output incl. hostile text; real analyzer snapshot fixture; e2e 4/4 with exact bundled values; drift tests for both mirrors.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No new process or request; extractor is linear and bounded.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New modules small (<110 lines), mapper free of React, CONTROL regex shared once.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: wizard -> monorepo brief_intake (verified), analyzer snapshot -> findings -> UI (fixture + shape sync).
